confirmed_header_rules.numeric_directive: skip a line only when every character after # parses as one signed Int32
confirmed_header_rules.multi_range_marker: any line containing #HABAHIRO enables multi-range conversion
confirmed_header_rules.wav_parse: #WAVxx value uses characters 4..5 as key and trimmed substring from index 7 as value
confirmed_header_rules.lookup_order: primary WAV dictionary before additive WAV dictionary
confirmed_header_rules.control_detection: scan primary WAV values for any of the eight cont_bezier or cont_force names
confirmed_header_rules.reparse: rebuild primary WAV entries, insert additive entries immediately after the original WAV block, remove control-WAV lines, and preserve remaining source lines
confirmed_header_rules.trailing_wav_block: no additive flush occurs when input ends inside the WAV block

confirmed_generated_wav_allocation.order: for index 1..50 allocate Slide A left, Slide A right, Slide B left, Slide B right

confirmed_note_text_rules.score_line: length at least 6, starts with #, and characters 1..5 parse as decimal Int32
confirmed_note_text_rules.absolute_position: 192 * numerator / denominator + 192 * bar using integer division

confirmed_partition_and_order_rules.normal: partition Slide A plus A controls, Slide B plus B controls, and default notes
confirmed_partition_and_order_rules.multi_range: sort each Slide family by absolute position then lane, merge consecutive same-position lanes into the left note width, then append family controls
confirmed_partition_and_order_rules.same_position_order: front control before ordinary notes and back control after ordinary notes
confirmed_partition_and_order_rules.force_order: apply force-front and force-back movement after NoteCompare ordering
confirmed_partition_and_order_rules.output: preserve reparsed source lines and append default, Slide A, and Slide B reconstructed score lines
